name: Dalaran Mana Gem
summary: Near Ambermill, Kirin Tor mages carry Dalaran Mana Gems to replenish their power. Forsaken tailors use the gems to weave enchanted robes.

sections.title: Stolen Arcana
sections.body: Kirin Tor mages, conjurors, and guards around Ambermill carry mana gems to focus and replenish their arcane power. In the Undercity’s Magic Quarter, Forsaken practitioners prize the gems as a ready supply of concentrated magic. Some undead mages share an academic heritage with Dalaran, but survival comes first. To the Forsaken, the Kirin Tor are rivals whose magical stores can be taken.

sections.title: Weaving the Spellfire
sections.body: Forsaken bring mana gems taken from fallen Kirin Tor operatives to tailors such as Josef Gregorian in the Undercity, along with simple linen. A tailor cannot channel arcane power directly, but can bind a gem into the cloth. The magic then strengthens the wearer’s connection to the arcane.

faq.q: Where do Dalaran Mana Gems come from?
faq.answer: Kirin Tor forces carry Dalaran Mana Gems in Silverpine Forest, especially around their encampments and outposts near Ambermill, southeast of the Sepulcher.

faq.q: What are these gems used for?
aliases: why do i need dalaran mana gems
faq.answer: Forsaken mages bring the gems with linen to Josef Gregorian in the Undercity. He uses them to weave spellfire robes.

faq.q: Why are the Kirin Tor in Silverpine carrying these gems?
aliases: why do dalaran wizards have gems
faq.answer: Kirin Tor members carry mana gems as personal stores of arcane power. The gems sustain their spellcasting, defense wards, and conjurations in hostile Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken target Dalaran mages for these gems?
faq.answer: Forsaken and Dalaran share an academic heritage, but the Forsaken see their living counterparts as rivals. Undercity mentors believe a mage who cannot defend their arcane wealth is too weak to survive, so they take the mage’s components.

angles.text: As a Forsaken mage, you are sent to take these gems as a rite of passage, proving your martial skill and mastery of harvested arcane power.
As an undead traveler, you know the Forsaken set aside sentiment for former human colleagues in Dalaran to support their faction’s survival.
